section_title: Basic pitched-roof envelopes for certain districts - R1/R2 group-label enumeration and 25/35 ft caps

verbatim_excerpt:
R1 R2 R3A R3X R3-1 R3-2 R4 R4-1 R4A R5A

In the districts indicated, the height and setback regulations for single- or two-family detached, semi-detached, or zero lot line buildings or other structures, where permitted, shall be set forth in this Section.

The perimeter walls of a building or other structure are those portions of the outermost walls enclosing the floor area within a building or other structure at any level and height is measured from the base plane. Perimeter walls are subject to setback regulations at a maximum height above the base plane of 25 feet.

Above these heights, sloping planes control the maximum height of the building or other structure requiring either a setback or a pitched roof. These planes start at the maximum permitted height of the perimeter walls and meet at a ridge line of 35 feet above the base plane. The exact locations of these planes are flexible and are determined in the following steps set forth in paragraphs (a) through (g).

district_enumeration.anchor: 23-421 opening district list (first line of the section body)
district_enumeration.note: This section applies ONE uniform pitched-roof envelope (25 ft perimeter wall / 35 ft ridge, both above the base plane) to every district in this single enumerated list. Only the BARE labels 'R1' and 'R2' appear in this line - NOT R1-1, R1-2, R1-2A, R2A, or R2X. The extension of this envelope to those five lettered/numeric-suffix variants is encoded in a SEPARATE ruleset (r1_r2_suffix_variants_pitched_height.rule.json) citing zr-11-25, carrying explicit OWNER-DECISION provenance (D-049, 2026-09-13) rather than an express per-variant citation of this line. R3A/R3X/R3-1/R3-2/R4/R4-1/R4A are the accepted M4-T014 R3/R4 family's scope (zr-23-421-r3-r4); R5A is the accepted M4-T006 R5 pilot's scope.

notes: Governs the pitched-roof envelope perimeter-wall height cap (25 ft) and ridge/building height cap (35 ft), both above the base plane, for the bare 'R1' and 'R2' district labels this snapshot's excerpt names directly.

The sloping-plane setback construction (paragraphs (a) through (f)) is deliberately NOT transcribed in this excerpt - it remains a typed A2 gap (D-045-R008), surfaced as a documented limitation, never reduced to a number.

Paragraph (g) (the 5-ft reference-plane allowance for R1/R2 districts without a letter suffix) is captured SEPARATELY as snapshot zr-23-421-g so the (g)-conditional rule's citation is unambiguous and independently hash-verified.

Captured fresh in-task for M4-T012 as the governing-source snapshot for the bare-R1/R2 pitched-roof height DRAFT rule (r1_r2_bare_pitched_height.rule.json, needs_review) and cited (alongside zr-11-25) by the suffix-variant rule for the shared numeric caps.
Nothing in this record is a Verified zoning determination. Verified requires an M4 published rule plus G6 qualified-human approval (owner directive item 5).
